posts.text:
Sunday, Nov 22: Toronto's streetcars lost 753 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 510 Spadina northbound. A typical 5.5 km trip lost 14 min (usually 13).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch westbound, 11 min over 8.0 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Sunday's slowest spot: Westbound on Dundas St East, between Church St and Victoria St.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 58 s here (usually 59 s). Across 260 trips, that adds up to 12.9 hours.
The biggest share was at the Church St light, which has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Dundas St East around Church St, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the westbound stretch between Church St and Victoria St is highlighted, adding up to about 2 min 58 s lost per streetcar.

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Sunday, Nov 22: 510 Spadina. 1 in 8 trips (49) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side (southbound, 31), instead of going on to Union Station.

Across all routes, 7% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 510 Spadina route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side, gives how many southbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Union Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Sunday, Nov 22: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

38% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 259 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 38% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Sunday, Nov 22: at the busiest moment (1:00 pm), 128 streetcars were in service, against 139 scheduled.
Overall, 94% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 782 hours on streetcar routes.
Furthest behind: 505 Dundas, at 82% of its scheduled service.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Sunday, Nov 22, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 128 streetcars at 1:00 pm, against 139 scheduled; over the day 94% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Sunday, Nov 22: Dundas St East at Broadview Ave (505 Dundas eastbound).

Riders waited 7.9 min on average, against 3.2 if cars had come as scheduled: 4.7 min extra. 31% of cars came bunched, and 43 of 176 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Dundas St East at Broadview Ave in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 4.7 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
